style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm home-storage commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm beige wall #EDE3D4, light warm grey #F2F1EF, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one warm terracotta orange accent #D9622B; warm temperature; alternating backgrounds of seamless beige gradient wall, light grey tile wall and warm wood countertop #B08050, with deep charcoal info screens as rhythm breaks; bright soft warm studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and gentle raking side light for texture; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin-line terracotta icons with rounded rectangular info cards; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented certification text on any screen
style.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle on wood countertop; consistent product scale across screens; infographic screens keep product small and subordinate to layout
style.surfaceSystem: warm wood countertop and matte light-grey stone tile, rounded white info cards floating above surfaces
